pages.title: Alloys
pages.text:
The Alloy Forge makes ten alloys, shown on the next pages.

Recipes use the common ingot tags, so copper, zinc, gold, and iron from other mods work too.

pages.title: Brass
pages.text:
**3 copper ingots** and **1 zinc ingot** make 4 Brass Ingots.

See [Brass](entry://materials/brass) for its gear.

pages.title: Rose Gold
pages.text:
**3 gold ingots** and **1 copper ingot** make 2 Rose Gold Ingots.

See [Rose Gold](entry://materials/rose_gold) for its gear.

pages.title: Sakura
pages.text:
**1 iron ingot** and **4 pink petals** make 1 Sakura Ingot. Pink petals carpet the ground in cherry groves.

See [Sakura](entry://materials/sakura) for its gear.

pages.title: Steel
pages.text:
**1 iron ingot** and **2 coal or charcoal** make 1 Steel Ingot. It takes a little longer than the other alloys.

See [Steel](entry://materials/steel) for its gear.

pages.title: Reinforced Obsidian
pages.text:
**2 obsidian** and **1 iron ingot** make 1 Reinforced Obsidian. It takes a little longer than most alloys.

See [Obsidian](entry://materials/obsidian) for its gear.

pages.title: Echo
pages.text:
**1 echo shard**, **4 sculk**, and **2 iron ingots** make 2 Echo Ingots. It takes a little longer than most alloys.

See [Echo](entry://materials/echo) for its gear.

pages.title: Princess Gold
pages.text:
**2 gold ingots**, **1 amethyst shard**, and **1 pink dye** make 2 Princess Gold Ingots.

See [Pastel Princess](entry://materials/pastel_princess) for its gear.

pages.title: Heartbreak Ingot
pages.text:
**1 diamond**, **1 crying obsidian**, and **2 gunpowder** make 1 Heartbreak Ingot. It takes a little longer than most alloys.

See [Jirai Kei](entry://materials/jirai_kei) for its gear.

pages.title: Sparkle Gem
pages.text:
**1 diamond**, **2 amethyst shards**, and **2 glowstone dust** make 1 Sparkle Gem. It takes a little longer than most alloys.

See [Magical Girl](entry://materials/magical_girl) for its gear.

pages.title: Fairy Ingot
pages.text:
**1 iron ingot**, **2 feathers**, and **1 light blue dye** make 1 Fairy Ingot.

See [Fairy Kei](entry://materials/fairy_kei) for its gear.
